UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated shopper profile synced from Firebase Authentication.

uid.description: Firebase Auth user UID matching the document ID.

fullName.description: Display name of the authenticated shopper.

email.description: Verified email address of the authenticated shopper.

photoURL.description: Optional profile avatar URL from the identity provider.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private shopper profile documents accessible strictly by the owning authenticated user.
